caption: The drawing features two separate objects placed side by side on a plain, off-white background. On the left, there is a tall, tripod stand with a circular base and three curved legs; extending vertically from the base is a rod with a looped ring at the top and four evenly spaced, pronounced notches or hooks along one side. This object is rendered in shades of brown and dark gold, giving it a metallic appearance with some areas suggesting rust or wear. On the right, there is a rectangular, box-like apparatus with a liftable, hinged lid and a simple, rectangular handle on top. The box stands on four outward-curving legs and features a spout-like protrusion and a lever on the right side. The surface of the box is mottled with varying tones of blue-gray and brown, also giving the appearance of aged or rusted metal. The overall composition is centered, and there is a signature “J.C. Cribella” in the lower right corner.
title: Clock Jack
